versions.description_html:
Learn how to use Fabric Notebooks without a developer background. Discover non-developer workflows, spark notebooks, and data transformation basics.

Imagine opening a Fabric notebook for the first time and seeing code, data, strange errors, and words you’ve never used before. It feels like you’ve walked into a room built for developers, while your job is simply to get data you can trust.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Opening: The Code Wall Is Not the Real Problem
  • What a Fabric Spark Notebook Actually Is
  • The Five Parts of the Notebook Screen
  • The Non-Developer Workflow: Explore Before You Transform
  • Transform Data Without Turning the Notebook Into a Mystery
  • From Personal Experiment to Repeatable Fabric Process
  • When You Should Use a Notebook, and When You Shouldn’t
  • Conclusion: Start With One Question, Not a Huge Build

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Train AI Models with Microsoft Fabric Notebooks
  • Manage Git Integration for Microsoft Fabric Notebooks
  • More Data & Fabric episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Data & Fabric: the most-listened episodes
